blueprint.name: BNK Live Observability Foundation
blueprint.description: Deploys a reusable cloud-agnostic Loki log store and Fluent Bit collector foundation for live BNK PoC telemetry. Works with any Kubernetes cluster via direct kubeconfig — no existing Forge cluster registration required. Defaults match Forge AI Gateway observability settings (observability_namespace=llm-egress, loki_service_name=loki, loki_port=3100). This blueprint creates a new Forge project; after deploy, register the same cluster in Forge (Settings > Clusters) to enable the PR #393 Loki dashboard. Producer blueprints emit real structured JSON logs into Loki; this blueprint does not generate synthetic data.

outcomes: Cluster kubeconfig validated and connectivity confirmed
Kubernetes namespace 'llm-egress' (or custom) created and labelled
Loki log store running as a single-replica Deployment with ClusterIP Service
Fluent Bit DaemonSet collecting live pod logs and forwarding JSON-structured records to Loki
Loki /ready confirmed via Kubernetes API-server proxy
Foundation ready for traffic-producing blueprints to emit real logs

prerequisites.description: A Kubernetes cluster kubeconfig must be available. The kubeconfig is provided as a blueprint input — no prior Forge cluster registration is required. BNK must already be installed if you intend to use Forge AI Gateway features that query Loki. After this blueprint deploys, register the cluster in Forge (Settings > Clusters) to enable the PR #393 Loki dashboard cluster-selector.

input_summary.label: Cluster name
input_summary.value: Required. A human-readable name for the cluster (e.g. 'my-onprem-k8s'). Used in Forge project labels and registration guidance.

input_summary.label: Kubeconfig
input_summary.value: Required (sensitive). Full plain-text kubeconfig for the target cluster. Stored as a project secret. Supports any Kubernetes cluster.

input_summary.label: Observability namespace
input_summary.value: Default: llm-egress. Must match the observability_namespace setting in Forge AI Gateway (PR #393).

input_summary.label: Loki service name / port
input_summary.value: Default: loki / 3100. Must match the Forge AI Gateway loki_service_name and loki_port settings.

input_summary.label: Loki retention
input_summary.value: Default: 24 hours (PoC). Set loki_retention_hours=168 for a 7-day rolling window.

input_summary.label: Pod log collection
input_summary.value: Default: enabled. Set enable_pod_log_collection=false to skip the Fluent Bit DaemonSet if your cluster already has a log collector.

required.name: cluster_name
required.description: Human-readable name for the target cluster (e.g. 'my-onprem-k8s'). Used in Forge project labels. After deploy, register this same cluster in Forge (Settings > Clusters > Add cluster) to enable the PR #393 Loki dashboard.

required.name: kubeconfig_content
required.description: Full plain-text kubeconfig for the target Kubernetes cluster. Supports any cluster (EKS, AKS, GKE, ROKS, on-prem). Stored as a project secret and passed to every module as forge_kubeconfig_content. Never logged or stored in plaintext outputs.

optional.name: observability_namespace
optional.description: Kubernetes namespace for all live observability components. Must match the observability_namespace value in Forge AI Gateway settings.

optional.name: loki_service_name
optional.description: Kubernetes Service name for Loki. Must match the loki_service_name value in Forge AI Gateway settings.

optional.name: loki_port
optional.description: Loki HTTP port. Must match the loki_port value in Forge AI Gateway settings.

optional.name: loki_retention_hours
optional.description: Loki chunk and index retention in hours. Default 24 h is suitable for PoC environments with emptyDir storage. Use 168 for a 7-day rolling window.

optional.name: enable_pod_log_collection
optional.description: Deploy the Fluent Bit DaemonSet for live pod log collection. Set false if your cluster already has a log collector or you only want direct-push producers.

optional.name: poc_label
optional.description: Value for the bnk-forge/poc label added to the observability namespace. Useful for grouping resources in multi-PoC clusters.

optional.name: readiness_timeout_seconds
optional.description: Seconds to wait for Loki to become ready. Increase if your cluster has slow image pulls.

modules.name: Adopt cluster via kubeconfig
modules.description: Validates kubeconfig connectivity to the target cluster. Writes kubeconfig to disk (0600) and confirms kubectl can reach the API server before any Kubernetes resources are created. Does not auto-register the cluster in Forge — see README for manual registration instructions.

modules.name: Create observability namespace
modules.description: Creates and labels the Kubernetes namespace for all live observability components.

modules.name: Deploy Loki log store
modules.description: Deploys single-replica Grafana Loki as plain Kubernetes manifests with a ClusterIP Service.

modules.name: Deploy Fluent Bit collector
modules.description: Deploys Fluent Bit as a DaemonSet that tails live pod logs, promotes model/status/job as Loki labels, and forwards to Loki.

modules.name: Verify observability stack readiness
modules.description: Polls Loki /ready via the Kubernetes API-server service proxy. Marks the foundation ready for traffic-producing blueprints.
